title: File offset of an address
description:
Convert a virtual address in a program you built to its position in the file.

```
image base 0x140000000
.text   RVA 0x1000 size 0x2000 at file 0x400
VA 0x140001234 -> RVA 0x1234 -> .text -> file offset 0x634
```
hints: `std::optional<T>` (from `<optional>`) holds either a `T` or nothing. `return value;` gives back a filled one and `return std::nullopt;` an empty one. A caller tests it with `if (result)` (or `result.has_value()`) and reads the value inside with `*result`.
An RVA past the raw size of its section is in memory only (zero-filled).
requirements: Sections have a name, RVA, virtual size, raw offset and raw size.
VA to RVA, RVA to section, section to file offset; say when an address is not backed by the file.
stretch: Patch a byte at that offset in a copy of your own program and run it.
